confidence_notes: Meal, cappuccino and draft-beer anchors use recent crowd-sourced Bangalore prices. The cocktail index is sparse and reflects a downtown club, so cocktail and wine-glass estimates are tempered using the local draft-beer price relationship. Accommodation values are holistic estimates from general knowledge; no live listings were checked.
comparable_city_reasoning: Bengaluru is a large Indian technology and business metro; lodging estimates use a broad major-Indian-city basis, while food and drink estimates use Bangalore city price indexes.
